mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_detect (entry_url, title, status, started_at, tool_version, created_at) VALUES (#{entry_url}, #{title}, 'RUNNING', datetime('now', 'localtime'), #{tool_version}, datetime('now', 'localtime'))
mapper.update: UPDATE t_detect SET detected_cms = #{detected_cms} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_detect SET status = #{status}, finished_at = datetime('now', 'localtime'), elapsed_sec = #{elapsed_sec}, total_pages = #{total_pages}, violation_count = #{violation_count} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_detect_list ( master_id, finding_id, url, is_violation, location, evidence_text, technique, extra_finding, created_at ) VALUES ( #{master_id}, #{finding_id}, #{url}, #{is_violation}, #{location}, #{evidence_text}, #{technique}, #{extra_finding}, datetime('now', 'localtime') ) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO t_detect_log ( master_id, url, input_ko, prompt_en, response_en, response_ko, similarity_val, is_illegal, confidence, model_name, device_mode, created_at ) VALUES ( #{master_id}, #{url}, #{input_ko}, #{prompt_en}, #{response_en}, #{response_ko}, #{similarity_val}, #{is_illegal}, #{confidence}, #{model_name}, #{device_mode}, datetime('now', 'localtime') )
mapper.select: SELECT id, master_id, url, input_ko, prompt_en, response_en, response_ko, similarity_val, is_illegal, confidence, model_name, device_mode, created_at FROM t_detect_log WHERE master_id = #{master_id} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT t.id, t.entry_url, t.title, t.detected_cms, t.status, t.started_at, t.finished_at, CASE WHEN t.elapsed_sec > 0 THEN t.elapsed_sec ELSE COALESCE(MAX(0, CAST(ROUND((julianday(t.finished_at) - julianday(t.started_at)) * 86400) AS INTEGER)), 0) END AS elapsed_sec, t.total_pages, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT f.url, f.location, f.technique FROM t_detect_list f WHERE f.master_id = t.id GROUP BY f.url, f.location, f.technique)) AS violation_count, t.tool_version, t.created_at FROM t_detect t WHERE t.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_detect_solution (master_id, finding_id, target_text, clean_title, clean_body, updated_at) VALUES (#{master_id}, #{finding_id}, #{target_text}, #{clean_title}, #{clean_body}, datetime('now', 'localtime')) ON CONFLICT (master_id, finding_id) DO UPDATE SET target_text = excluded.target_text, clean_title = excluded.clean_title, clean_body = excluded.clean_body, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT id, master_id, finding_id, url, is_violation, location, evidence_text, technique, extra_finding, created_at FROM t_detect_list WHERE master_id = #{master_id} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, master_id, parent_id, depth, url, path_segment, title, http_status, has_violation, violation_cnt, created_at FROM t_detect_node WHERE master_id = #{master_id} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, entry_url, title, status, started_at, finished_at, elapsed_sec, total_pages, violation_count, tool_version, created_at FROM t_detect ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_sites, COALESCE(SUM(total_pages), 0) AS total_pages, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT master_id, url, location, technique FROM t_detect_list GROUP BY master_id, url, location, technique)) AS total_violations, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_sites FROM t_detect
SELECT technique, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM (SELECT master_id, url, location, technique FROM t_detect_list WHERE is_violation = 1 GROUP BY master_id, url, location, technique) GROUP BY technique

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN evidence_text LIKE '%카지노%' OR evidence_text LIKE '%슬롯%' OR evidence_text LIKE '%바카라%' OR evidence_text LIKE '%토토%' OR evidence_text LIKE '%베팅%' OR evidence_text LIKE '%BET%' OR evidence_text LIKE '%놀이터%' OR evidence_text LIKE '%먹튀%' OR evidence_text LIKE '%충전%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS gambling_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN evidence_text LIKE '%성인%' OR evidence_text LIKE '%조건%' OR evidence_text LIKE '%출장%' OR evidence_text LIKE '%야동%' OR evidence_text LIKE '%섹스%' OR evidence_text LIKE '%만남%' OR evidence_text LIKE '%애인%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS adult_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN evidence_text LIKE '%대출%' OR evidence_text LIKE '%소액%' OR evidence_text LIKE '%일수%' OR evidence_text LIKE '%현금화%' OR evidence_text LIKE '%폰테크%' OR evidence_text LIKE '%월변%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS loan_cnt, COUNT(*) AS total_cnt FROM t_detect_list WHERE is_violation = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cnt, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(similarity_val * 100), 1), 0) AS avg_sim_score, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(confidence), 1), 0) AS avg_confidence, SUM(CASE WHEN is_illegal = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS illegal_cnt FROM t_detect_log
